stem:
Rohan picks grit out of uncooked dal. Kavita collects butter while churning curd.

What is true about these separations?

options.text: Picking grit removes an unwanted part; churning collects a useful part.
Both actions only remove unwanted parts.
Both actions are only stirring food, so they are not separations.
Picking grit collects a useful part; churning removes an unwanted part.

teacher.key_rationale: Separation can remove an unwanted component or collect a useful one. Grit is unwanted. Butter is useful and collected by churning.
